subject.title: fix(config): improve validation error messages with line numbers, bracket paths, and received values

question: May terminal config-validation errors display effective environment- and include-resolved values when the path passes the current sensitive-path and SecretRef filters?
rationale: The accurate value is the resolved value validation rejected, but displaying resolved data can expose secrets on plugin-owned or otherwise unclassified paths; source inspection cannot establish the intended disclosure contract.

options.title: Approve bounded effective values
options.body: Use the effective validated configuration for value hints and strengthen tests and redaction rules for environment substitutions, includes, SecretRefs, and plugin-owned sensitive paths.

options.title: Show authored values only
options.body: Keep hints limited to literal values present in the source file and suppress them when substitution or includes mean the authored value differs from the validated value.

options.title: Remove value hints
options.body: Land only bracketed paths and source locations, avoiding a new value-disclosure surface.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded effective values
recommendation.body: Use the effective validated configuration for value hints and strengthen tests and redaction rules for environment substitutions, includes, SecretRefs, and plugin-owned sensitive paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most directly to config snapshot semantics, SecretRef preflight, and validation behavior.
